cases.title: Runtime observation
cases.observed: Original runtime_info returned bounded invalid_input directing a v8 process to runtime_info_v2 (documented contract). runtime_info_v2 returned bridge 1.0.0, stdio, operator-supplied design registry v8 (2 entries), operator-supplied PDK registry v2 (2 entries), analysis journal operator_supplied, sweep journal package_relative_default; health/execution/environment assessed=false; remote_contact=false.
cases.expected_vs_actual: Requester anticipated v7; current main documents operator v8 with the v2 observation tool, so v8 is consistent with the latest contract and is not CONFIG_MISMATCH. The sweep journal uses the historical package-relative default rather than an explicit operator selection, which current documentation recommends for installations; recorded as a configuration observation, not a server failure.
cases.not_verified: Journal health, execution authority, registry file identity versus an operator-approved digest.

cases.title: Design discovery
cases.observed: Two registered designs (DESIGN_A amplifier reference, DESIGN_B RC fixture), both unqualified with execution_authorized=false. DESIGN_A describe: dc/ac/tran, three variables, three measurements, five corners, protected source, owned-copy policy, bindings not_resolved, spec not_evaluated. PDK status: fixed_native_compatibility for dc/ac/tran; generic_execution_qualified=false.
cases.expected_vs_actual: Registered lookup success is kept separate from generic execution, which remains unqualified.
cases.not_verified: DESIGN_B was listed but not described.

cases.title: Catalog inspection
cases.observed: Three native analyses (fixed NN/27 C/VDD 1 V operating point, no caller parameters, cancellation unsupported). Three registered measurements with fixed units. Six analog definitions: gain and bandwidth read-eligible; phase margin, legacy analog power, offset and slew rate read_eligible=false with explicit blocking reasons. Catalog exposes one separate signed DC power reader and one targetless v2 power specification.
cases.expected_vs_actual: No invented items. Missing targets are represented as not_selected / not_evaluated.
cases.not_verified: Submit/cancel/write tools were observed as exposed names only and were never called.

cases.title: Existing native DC read
cases.observed: DC_OP_1 is found in the live analysis journal. state/stage/simulator/extraction are succeeded and the last update is 2026-09-30. The bounded result has quality valid, the fixed NN / 27 C / VDD 1 V / applied bias 0.32/0.702 V settings, 7 scalar records in V, protected_unchanged=true, source-copy signature equal, 2 historical warnings, 0 notices and spec_evaluation not_evaluated.
cases.expected_vs_actual: Units and fixed conditions match the registered native-dc contract. The returned plan hash equals the hash from list_analyses. No baseline result hash was supplied, so equality with earlier private evidence is not claimed beyond the power value check in C08.
cases.not_verified: Equality with an independently held baseline frame hash; a fresh blanket guest fingerprint check (the protected flag is per-result).

cases.title: Existing native AC / TRAN reads
cases.observed: AC_OP_1 and TRAN_OP_1 both succeeded with quality valid and the same fixed settings. AC returned a 72-point differential spectrum from 10 Hz to 100 MHz in Hz, V/V, dB and deg. TRAN returned a bounded summary: 754 adaptive points over 0-4 ms, stimulus_verified=true, no FFT. Source, model and circuit identities are the same across DC/AC/TRAN, while input, PSF and frame identities are analysis-specific.
cases.expected_vs_actual: Matches the registered AC/TRAN contracts. Raw values are not published.
cases.not_verified: Equality with independently held baseline hashes.

cases.title: Registered measurement reads
cases.observed: dc-scalars on DC_OP_1, ac-spectrum on AC_OP_1 and tran-summary on TRAN_OP_1 each returned quality valid with full provenance: plan, contract and definition hashes, reader native-bounded-result-v1 and per-result protected_unchanged=true. Measurement frames equal those of the corresponding analysis_result reads.
cases.expected_vs_actual: Every read used the described contract hash; no new extraction occurred.

cases.title: Analog gain / bandwidth / missing metrics
cases.observed: analog-gain on AC_OP_1 is QUALIFIED at reference_frequency 10 Hz, unit dB, and is not relabelled as DC or maximum gain. analog-bandwidth on AC_OP_1 is PARTIALLY_QUALIFIED (sampled_reference_log_frequency_interpolation_no_error_bound) with a finite crossing bracket. analog-phase-margin is UNQUALIFIED (qualified_loop_gain_measurement_unavailable) and legacy analog-power v1 on DC_OP_1 is UNQUALIFIED (qualified_signed_supply_current_set_unavailable). Both return value null.
cases.expected_vs_actual: Contract-compliant states. UNQUALIFIED does not mean the quantity is measurable. No target exists, so no design PASS/FAIL is produced.
cases.not_verified: Offset and slew rate results (definitions already non-eligible). The extra cadence_bandwidth_study_result was not called because it is outside the reviewed inventory.

cases.title: Dedicated power path
cases.observed: The dc-supply-power-v1 reader was called on DC_OP_1 with its own described contract hash. It returned QUALIFIED in W with all six signed sources (2 supply, 2 bias, 2 stimulus), supply-rail power separate from the bias/input contributions, and extraction, frame and provenance hashes. Its provenance plan, source and frame identities equal the C04 DC result.
cases.expected_vs_actual: The supply-rail value equals the repository-recorded preserved reference value for this operating point (docs/MEASUREMENT_BINDINGS_V2.md). The legacy analog-power v1 stays UNQUALIFIED on the same operation (C07). This split is the documented contract, not a failure.
cases.not_verified: Any other operation or condition; the reader is qualified for the preserved reference DC only.

cases.title: Specification
cases.observed: Legacy list returns no v1 specifications (target_status not_selected). Catalog shows one registered targetless v2 power specification. The legacy describe tool rejects that v2 ID as not registered; the v2 evaluator with its catalog contract hash returns NOT_EVALUATED / target_not_selected with no measurement read and no operation.
cases.expected_vs_actual: Consistent with the separate v8 power-specification array and v2 evaluator. Reviewers may want the legacy describe error text to point to the catalog for v2 IDs; not a failure.
cases.not_verified: Any PASS/FAIL comparison (no target is registered; none was created).

cases.title: Preserved sweep read
cases.observed: For the user-supplied completed SWEEP_OP_1 on DESIGN_B, the server returned bounded invalid_input 'Unknown registered sweep admission'. The live registration selects the package-relative default sweep journal (C01), not an explicitly configured historical sweep journal.
cases.expected_vs_actual: This is consistent with a configuration mismatch, not a server failure. The journal setting was not changed, replaced or reloaded, because that is outside this run's scope. No other sweep IDs or tools were tried.
cases.not_verified: Sweep status/result content. It requires an operator-approved explicit sweep journal in the Claude registration plus a restart.

cases.title: Storage read only
cases.observed: One summary and one list page (14 artifacts, complete, no next page). All six registered groups scanned; coverage complete. Logical managed bytes about 18.0 MB versus allocated about 48.3 MB; all artifacts PROTECTED_OR_UNKNOWN (replay or evidence required); potential reclaim 0. Cumulative reservation 7,383,023,616 of 10,737,418,240 bytes; Spectre attempts 64 of 500. Filesystem free observed above the disk floor (status OK); exact value private. Totals cover registered result roots only, not whole-VM usage.
cases.expected_vs_actual: Counters are higher than the last repository-recorded 62 attempts / 7,114,588,160 bytes by 2 attempts / 268,435,456 bytes (two 128 MiB reservations). This session called no submit tool; the cause was not determined here.
cases.not_verified: Describe artifact (not needed). Cleanup plan/dry-run/execute and deletion E2E: NOT_RUN.

cases.title: Safe rejection and recovery
cases.observed: Two well-formed unregistered logical IDs: both SERVER_REJECTED with bounded invalid_input, retryable=false, no details. Subsequent runtime_info_v2 and list_designs succeeded with identical content.
cases.expected_vs_actual: This is a two-request rejection check only, not a security audit.
cases.not_verified: Malformed, oversized, traversal or write-path requests (intentionally not attempted).

cases.title: Repeated read
cases.observed: Repeated local runtime/design reads and repeated remote DC_OP_1 analysis_result and power_measurement_result calls returned identical content. This was a direct string comparison of the returned values, including frame, native-result and extraction hashes.
cases.expected_vs_actual: Stable results across repeat; no hash was computed by the agent.
cases.not_verified: Counter invariance across reads (storage summary taken once, before the result reads).

cases.observed: RESTART_NOT_VERIFIED. Awaiting a human quit and relaunch of Claude Desktop.
